name: Fitness Regime
description: {driver} started an intensive fitness regime and is in peak physical shape.

name: Burnout
description: {driver} is mentally exhausted and struggling to find motivation.

name: Personal Coach
description: {driver} hired a world-class personal performance coach.

name: Karting Holiday
description: {driver} spent the offseason karting and rediscovered their love of raw racecraft.

name: Intense Rivalry
description: {driver} has become locked in an intense personal rivalry that's sharpened their focus.

name: Data Obsessed
description: {driver} became obsessed with data analysis and is extracting every tenth from the car.

name: Sim Racing Addiction
description: {driver} is spending every spare minute in a simulator and it's actually working.

name: Rising Star
description: {driver} is talked about as one of the next great talents and is living up to the hype.

name: Veteran Refocus
description: {driver} has found a second wind, drawing on experience to compensate for declining pace.

name: Broken Wrist
description: {driver} suffered a broken wrist in a cycling accident and is returning to the cockpit ahead of schedule.

name: Chronic Back Injury
description: {driver} is managing a persistent back injury that flares up under heavy G-forces.

name: Laser Eye Surgery
description: {driver} got laser eye surgery and is astonished by the improvement in their vision.

name: Altitude Training
description: {driver} spent the winter at high altitude and reports remarkable gains in stamina.

name: Crash Confidence Crisis
description: {driver} walked away from a nasty shunt but is struggling to commit fully to the limit.

name: Cold Plunge Devotee
description: {driver} adopted an extreme cold plunge routine, sitting in ice baths for an hour daily. They swear it works. Their lips are permanently blue.

name: Hypnotherapy
description: {driver} tried hypnotherapy to improve focus and now enters a trance-like state before every race that deeply unnerves the grid.

name: Sleep Optimisation
description: {driver} hired a sleep scientist and follows a rigid 26-step bedtime routine. They've never felt more rested or more boring at parties.

name: Fighter Pilot Training
description: {driver} spent the offseason training with fighter pilots and reports dramatic improvements in reaction time and G-force tolerance.

name: Extreme Diet
description: {driver} adopted an extreme diet of raw fish and kelp. They've lost weight and their skin has taken on a faintly green tinge.

name: Extreme Neck Training
description: {driver} did extreme neck-strengthening all winter. They can withstand 7G without flinching and their neck is now wider than their head.

name: Pre-Race Ritual
description: {driver} developed an elaborate 45-minute pre-race ritual involving three left turns, a specific sandwich, and a lucky sock. It does nothing.

name: Rain Phobia
description: {driver} developed an irrational fear of wet conditions after an offseason incident involving a garden hose. They won't discuss it.

name: Visualisation Expert
description: {driver} mastered an advanced visualisation technique and can drive a perfect lap in their mind with their eyes closed.

name: Esports Crossover
description: {driver} competed in a professional esports tournament and the hand-eye coordination crossover has been genuinely remarkable.

name: Yoga Devotee
description: {driver} became a devoted yoga practitioner and is notably more flexible — and notably more annoying about telling everyone.

name: Acupuncture Breakthrough
description: {driver} credits a course of acupuncture with unlocking a new level of body awareness. Doctors are sceptical but results speak for themselves.

name: Dramatic Weight Loss
description: {driver} lost dramatic weight over the winter. The car is faster, but the paddock is concerned about the biscuit-only diet.

name: Martial Arts Training
description: {driver} earned a black belt in jiu-jitsu. Reflexes are sharper but they keep trying to armbar journalists who ask annoying questions.
